facts.fact: 早晨与 Sam 谋划后，Jordan 和妈妈 Suzie 在 Serenique 水疗馆做美甲足疗和按摩。
facts.anchor: After a morning of scheming with Sam, Jordan met up with her mom at Serenique, Tranquil Cove’s salon and spa, for a mani-pedi and massage.

facts.fact: 因为 Lily 的缘故，Jordan 受到惩罚，如今竟开始害怕被独自留下。
facts.anchor: Thanks to Lily, Jordan was now being punished for doing what came naturally to her—pushing boundaries and taking risks.

facts.fact: Jordan 质问为何搬家，父母此前从未提过要离开亚特兰大重新开始。
facts.anchor: I just don’t understand why we’re moving. You and Dad never mentioned wanting to leave Atlanta or needing a fresh start before.

facts.fact: 爸爸短信称刚从银行回来、差点被止赎，父母一致同意这是唯一出路。
facts.anchor: Just got back from the bank. Barely avoided foreclosure. If this is the only way forward, S and I are in agreement.

facts.fact: Jordan 偷看短信太入神，没察觉妈妈已握紧拳头怒气冲冲走到身后。
facts.anchor: her tunnel vision keeping her from seeing someone stalking toward her with freshly painted toenails and hands clenched into fists.

facts.fact: 妈妈暂不告诉爸爸，但罚 Jordan 再停用手机一个月。
facts.anchor: I won’t tell your father about this until we get back to Atlanta. But consider your phone privileges revoked for another month.

facts.fact: Mika 的姑姑 Aiko 是热门 Netflix 肥皂剧《Amber Ridge》的演员。
facts.anchor: She’s on a popular Netflix soap opera. Amber Ridge. Ever heard of it?

facts.fact: 妈妈低声答应今晚解释一切，并叮嘱 Jordan 别向爸爸透露半个字。
facts.anchor: I’ll explain everything to you tonight,” she whispered. “Just don’t breathe a word of it to your dad.
